messages:
Rohan (Onboarding): FYI I sent the orientation invite for Thu 10/22 16:00 UTC. Two new hires in APAC said it showed as 00:00 and the Zoom passcode wasn't visible in Apple Calendar. Can we tighten the invite so everyone sees join info + recording location? cc @calendar-bot

Mei Zhang: Apple Calendar sometimes hides the passcode unless it's plain text in the description (not HTML). Also OWA webmail sometimes ignores the join link if the organizer uses angled brackets <> around the URL.

Liam O'Connor: I had an Exchange user last month whose desktop Outlook moved the event by an hour because the ICS lacked a proper VTIMEZONE block for Europe/London. Exported ICS from Google without TZ blocks causes trouble.

IT-Desk: Quick checklist: 1) create event with timezone set to UTC, 2) paste the Zoom URL and numeric passcode as separate lines in the description (no surrounding <>), 3) include a tiny local-times list (PST/CET/HKT/AEST), 4) verify exported ICS contains VTIMEZONE/TZID sections.

Rohan (Onboarding): Good notes. Any tips for Apple users where the preview strips links?

Mei Zhang: Put the join URL on its own line and also add a neat fallback like "Join via browser: https://zoom.us/j/XXXX (pass: 123456)". Apple will show plain text. Also avoid quotes in the description's first line 16 there was an Outlook parsing bug last quarter where curly quotes broke the ICS.

calendar-bot: Tip: Generate a UTC-based ICS with explicit TZ using this gcalcli example: `gcalcli add --when "2026-10-22 16:00" --duration 75 --title "Redwood New Hire Orientation" --description "Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/xxxx
Passcode: 123456
Local times: UTC 16:00 | PST 09:00 | CET 17:00 | HKT 00:00" --calendar "Onboarding"` then export the ICS and confirm it contains VTIMEZONE.

Liam O'Connor: After you recreate, can you also publish the calendar "Add to calendar" links to Notion and attach the exported ICS in the invite? That helped our EU hires.

Rohan (Onboarding): Plan: I'll recreate in UTC, add explicit plain-text join + passcode, paste a short local-times list, attach an exported ICS with TZ blocks, and publish the add-to-calendar links on Notion. I'll mark the event Busy and add an "APAC note" asking overnight attendees to DM for a recording if they can't attend live. Will post updated invite + Notion URL here by EOD.

IT-Desk: If anyone still sees a shift after that, reply with OS + calendar client (e.g., macOS Calendar 14 / Outlook 16 / Gmail mobile) and we'll hand-export an ICS per zone.

Mei Zhang: Thanks 1: will test the new invite on Apple Calendar once posted.

Rohan (Onboarding): Thanks all 1: updating now and will ping when done.
